notes.title: Fight of Steel Releases on Steam Today!
notes.content:
[h3]Today, June 14th, Digital Crafter released a whole new fighting game, Fight of Steel, after Fight of Animals was released on Steam two years ago. And we started developing free DLCs.
 
[previewyoutube=rqJOnlVLCbM;full][/previewyoutube]

Fight of Steel is a futuristic fighting game that sets its tone with metals. The story is all about fighter robots with advanced AI, aka STEEL. Players can assemble fighters with robot parts and Martial Art Chips they get in the game and develop their taste of fighting style from the look to the moves. Every STEEL a player build will be one of a kind.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f5398311785713cdbe397873568bc4f4c3b3b65.png[/img]
Players can buy the parts, color, basic moves, and Martial Art Chips in the shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/a4cd06caafaf480bc4e29f8656d5af0ea71275a7.png[/img]
The UI for fighter customization: The appearance and move sets are editable

Although a different theme from Fight of Animals, the input system is designed with the same modern approach, hoping more players can try and experience the charm of fighting games. Players can use simple inputs like pressing a direction and a skill button to perform Special moves. Fighting game veterans can also find excellent combos that require a deep understanding of the system with EX move and OVERDRIVE added to the game.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/b097179d961808d0ba00f10ff2257a300cc154f9.png[/img]
The control setting of the game

There are two other game modes in Fight of Steel, the Story Mode, and the Challenge Mode. In the Story Mode, players can join the main characters Zero and Artemis to venture into the Gears Faction area, fight the unknown enemies, and explore the world. Searching for the legendary "the Legacy of Humans," players can unlock different endings depending on the victory conditions.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/1dca5b77a1a92340d3d3a0dc879aa995f34af009.png[/img]
Story Mode screenshot 01
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/ee81ae72b7d29ad581ec06995d104b374d0309e1.png[/img]
Story Mode screenshot 02

Challenge Mode is a special kind of challenge. Players need to collect the right parts with the corresponding attributes for advantages. Different difficulties will unlock various robot parts or colors. There are World Files, some fragments of the information that describe tales about the world of Fight of Steel to collect in this Mode.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/71407d2e428517f7a1ced8b21ef61f433092ff95.png[/img]
Change attributes and stats to handle different enemies.

Fight of Steel releases on Steam today. In addition to the 10% discount on release, we planned some free DLC after release. Stay tuned.
[/h3]

notes.title: It’s time to join Steam Next Fest！！（Detailed Patch Note）
notes.content:
[h3]The Steam Next Fest in June started. Fight of Steel open demo is downloadable on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f64387bbc5a0bbda12dcb93bffe8096dd9c4778.jpg[/img]
We previously shared trailers for playable characters ET and Oil King. In this demo, you can redeem them freely in the Shop. ET and Oil King will stream Fight of Steel sometime this week and maybe they will be playing online matches with players. If you want to join the games, please keep an eye on our page. You might want to practice a little bit before the matches, or you want to play the game by yourself. Here are some tips for playing the game for the first time:

1. We would suggest you get familiar with the system by trying Training mode or Arcade mode. And then you can play Story mode to dip your toes in the world settings of Fight of Steel. In Story mode, there will be STEELs from the three factions showing up. We recommend you try Challenge mode later than the previous modes.

2. Online matches. You can play and practice Casual Match with your friend. If you want to challenge yourself, you could find some challenging players in Ranked Matches. Be warned, players in Ranked Matches are usually fierce.


Lastly, if you have clips of you playing the game, the interesting Skins you put together, and any thoughts you would like to share on social media, you can tag them with #FightOfSteel. That way it would be easier for us to get it!.


We welcome you to try the game![/h3]

notes.title: FOS Beta Test Tutorial
notes.content:
System Introduction
　●Select a character
　　○Once players are in the STEEL SELECT menu, First, a player needs to select a Stance. A Stance includes basic punch, kick, movement, and normal throw skills of a character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/d82b0897f7e3eed51ddab4059c3d37331b6aaa1b.png[/img]
　　○After selecting a Stance, players may swap 3 Skills and 1 Super Skill
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/c6b36e58351dee282df889f351fb156c9234d26b.png[/img]
　　○A player can also choose the preset Skins or Skill sets. A detailed description of settings is in the section Modes > Custom Steel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/115403fa103d6a390e9dbe9e29113a418661d982.png[/img]

　●Battle System
　　○Basic control
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/83a0726677e2e49b1500c669f0e87d6dc697d599.png[/img]
　　　　　■Keyboard controls
　　　　　　　　● WSAD 	Directions
　　　　　　　　● T		Light Attack
　　　　　　　　● H		Heavy Attack
　　　　　　　　● Y		Skill Attack
　　　　　　　　● G		Throw / Cancel Throw
　　　　　　　　● U		Overdrive
　　　　　　　　● J 		Super Skill

　　　　　■New Skills
　　　　　　　　● 6H
　　　　　　　　● 3H
　　　　　　　　● JS
　　　　　　　　● Direction + H + S	EX Skill

　　○Combo System
　　　　　■Because all the skills are changeable in this game, there is a template to combo a character’s skills
　　　　　　　　●After hitting with H, players can follow it with S
　　　　　　　　●After hitting with S, players can cancel the skill with 66
　　　　　　　　●After S hits, players can cancel the skill with an EX skill in different directions
　　　　　　　　●After EX hits, players can cancel the skill with an EX skill in different directions
　　　　　　　　●Some movements and skills can be jump canceled

　　○Gauge Usage
　　　　　■Normal Gauge
　　　　　　　　●An EX skill consumes 1 slot
　　　　　　　　●A Super Skill consumes 3 slots

　　　　　■Attack Overdrive
　　　　　　　　●Attack Overdrive can be used directly
　　　　　　　　●All movements and skills can be canceled by Overdrive
　　　　　　　　●During Overdrive, EX skills can be used without consuming gauges
　　　　　　　　●Attack Overdrive will cause a Wall Bounce once

　　　　　■Defense Overdrive
　　　　　　　　●Defense Overdrive can be used when blocking or being comboed
　　　　　　　　●Defense Overdrive won’t cause Wall Bounce

Modes
　●Story
　　○Currently, 3 stages opened

　●Arcade
　　○Fight against completely randomized opponents

　●Versus
　　○Note: Versus Mode will not reward credits

　●Online
　　○Ranked Match(Testing)
　　　　　■After setting desired connection quality, it will find an opponent with a similar rank
　　　　　■Players can check their score and rank on the leaderboard

　　○Casual Match
　　　　　■Use Fight of Animal structures
　　　　　■Implement control options related to the room host

　●Training
　　○Swapping skills and save skill sets are allowed in the Traning mode. Players can explore what kind of style they want to play here.

　●Challenge
　　○In Challenge mode, players will have to observe the attributes of opponents, like attack and weakness. Fight with suitable parts equipped, or they will eventually encounter enemies they can’t beat.
　　○Equipment acquired in Challenge mode can only be used in this mode. And players can't change the skins of these parts.
　　○Players can still use their favored skills to beat the levels. Body parts can enhance these skills. There will be some restrictions in future challenges.
　　○Players will get skins and World Files of Fight of Steel worldbuilding as prizes.

　●Custom Steel
　　○Skin
　　　　　■Players can change the skins of STEEL here and save them for later use on the STEEL Select page

　　○Skill
　　　　　■Players can swap skills for their STEEL here and save them for later use on the STEEL Select page.

　●Shop
　　○Players can buy skin, color, skills, and basic movements here
　　○Skins unlocked in Challenge mode will also appear here

notes.title: A Beta Test for Fight of Steel, a Robot Fighting Game, is Open For Registration
notes.content:
[h3]　　Digital Crafter announced today that their new fighting game, Fight of Steel, will hold a limited test play starting from April 27th. The game is said to be including elements of role-playing and adventure. And it is now open for application. They released the latest development progress video for the community.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/da436d172b12d25dcb47c9a1981f919f16d5c36a.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=QgwZTAr3pBs;full][/previewyoutube]
The game is still in the process of development. The developers improved game graphics and sound effects between the playtest version and the video.

[h3]　　Fight of Steel is a fighting game set in a futuristic mechanical style; it is the sequel to the Digital Crafter fighting games after two years. The game is with a very different style from the previous game, Fight of Animals. But the Digital Crafter team insists on making fighting games more accessible for players to enjoy the charm of fighting games. They simplified the input for moves. While the input commands are simplified, the EX move and the OVERDRIVE (overload) system allow veterans of fighting games to play with a more advanced game experience.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/0d791bfe6081bef82bca1e459df0143643814aab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2a1b90d036b2022963ce062db81941b3b400e0dd.png[/img]

[h3]　　The first easter egg released by the official team is the heroine of the story mode - Artemis. The first time a fighting game and VTuber collaborate. From the in-game artwork shared here, you can see Artemis wearing a combat suit. What kind of story and interaction will be between her and the protagonist?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/ae8e0d6f7c961a88561da29eb1113da141ee99b4.png[/img]
Does the mysterious girl who suddenly appears and is seriously injured relate to the protagonist's memory?

[h3]　　This beta test provides not only the general Arcade Mode but also other Modes of the game. The dev team included the first three chapters of the Story Mode, Challenge Mode, and Online Matches in the test version. Dozens of switchable moves and more than ten preset STEEL units so that players can experience other different aspects of the game other than fighting.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/94dc881246cfabc2eda25e930f40dd7ea675f68f.png[/img]
As the story mode progresses, you will encounter a variety of opponents

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2e49909be148e7d811595c9ad17e264551e92640.png[/img]
You can unlock different moves and parts in the shop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/e30ce5d8d771cc7d968d5b01d905c6b7269c9158.png[/img]
In Challenge Mode, players can build an optimized fighter according to the opponents encountered with the Property System design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/8b3ca2bb290f2f6d1bd8ec5530d3bd6c108e583b.png[/img]
Online matches are available during the beta test. Players can fight with pro players from all over the world.

[h3]　　Digital Crafter states that the beta test of Fight of Steel will last for seven days, from April 27th to May 4th. Players who applied for the playtest will receive a Steam key for the playtest on opening day. But they will remove the playtest data after the internal test ends. Along with this event, Digital Crafter will also release a lot of new information about the game in a few days. Players could get those updates by following their Facebook page or Steam game page.[/h3]

[h2][url=https://7obmow74ffw.typeform.com/to/RpKnmG8y]Application form for 1st wave beta test[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Behold! Fight of Steel x Fight of Animals Crossover!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Hx_jBOPGVfQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Fight of Steel is a fighting game with fighters of robots with advanced AI, STEEL (SenTient Engineered Evolving Life-form). Players may switch base fighting style “Stance” and combine with “parts” and “martial art chips” they acquire in the game to assemble fighters with their flavor and style. Characters in Fight of Animals will be in the game as “head parts”! Players who already own the game Fight of Animals will have these parts in their inventory at the start of Fight of Steel.


Simple control but still a game with depth:
The control of Fight of Steel is a spiritual successor of Fight of Animals. For players to enjoy the excitement of fighting games, special moves still use input combinations like “Foward + Skill Button”; Supers only require one button to trigger. You don’t need to memorize complicated commands to join the fight anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/4bbfa1d10828f7b14ad84be5378b0660b94e4a77.png[/img]
“Direction + Skill Button” for special moves installed

All the above being said, the development team also tried to add more depth to the simple control game; EX moves, enhanced special moves, and a new OVERDRIVE system provide more fun gameplay for players to explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/cc63e53fcd775e409ff664399f72dda2bc662117.png[/img]
EX move and OVERDRIVE add depth to the gameplay

In Fight of Steel, there are a few things designed for casual fighting game players aside from the traditional fighting elements. The game included a rich Story Mode with multiple endings, Arcade Mode, and Challenger Mode focused on collecting parts and adjusting build stats.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/dadec2a6474e79368d3d76d08ecf313aa5be97be.png[/img]
The protagonist will find his memory in the adventure

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/945be0485a64865a48243467e3d52050b1019d40.png[/img]
Collect parts and defeat your enemies in Challenge Mode. Collect fragments of information about “STEEL Verse” along the way.

There are more than 30 sets of STEEL with different styles and 70 moves for players to collect and assemble. Players can use the game modes described above to acquire them.

Fight of Steel is still in development. More information about the game will be available recently. A close beta test is coming soon. If you’re interested in joining the test play, please add the game to your wishlist!

Other two Stances are revealed today!

[previewyoutube=CvlWry33exo;full][/previewyoutube]
Survival Moves
Scavengers were born in a future without humans. The AI that awakens itself in the scrap iron factory was assembled, self-repaired, and generated. They have no concept about human beings, and their appearance has infinite possibilities, free, random, and uncontrollable. Compared with other factions that simulate human behavior, they are more like the original new species.


[previewyoutube=JX8a8TLtmI8;full][/previewyoutube]
Assault Combat Tactics
Protector was a defensive robot commissioned by government agencies and developed by private companies in the era of human existence. It was initially used for guarding and security work and was later transformed into assisting the military and police to attack through the period of unstable security. 
Its feature is that the AI core has an immutable setting for protecting its creator (aka human), which leads to the characteristic of their obsession with finding “human heritage”.

notes.title: Faction: Scavs
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/9457fd31c2bbd45fb2c1934d06bfd803ed25600a.png[/img]

In the old world they were the discarded STEEL. the Broken and the outdated. They existed for decades, dumped in the wastelands, in massive rusting piles of trash. But years ago, through some unknown means, their A.I. were reactivated. They have survived by collecting parts from scrap heaps, and when they have the opportunity, ripping parts off of any STEEL units who become too slow or careless.

They are easy to recognize, with a look distinct from the other two factions. Their irregularly constructed bodies crafted from whatever they can get their rusted hands on. Their move sets are also irregular and dangerously unpredictable. They know what it means to be reduced to scrap, and they will do anything to keep themselves online.

notes.title: Faction: Gears
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/1f7b465e16ffb3fbb0225c1e76a27a4887fff152.png[/img]

Like smaller parts of a bigger machine, gears all work together to further their unified goals. They were designed for logistics and daily administrative work. slaves to the principles of  function and efficiency. In the World of STEEL, units of this faction act according to pure reason and ruthless efficiency. They have judged organic life to be wasteful and inefficient. therefore their chosen course of action is to destroy any organics on sight. STEEL units of this faction may look a bit basic but their simple designs often hide deadly surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/718e2791ec2849d4553a9cd53457aecdce167321.png[/img]

Scavs:

But years ago, through some unknown means, their A.I. were reactivated. They have survived by collecting parts from scrap heaps, and when they have the opportunity, ripping parts off of any STEEL units who become too slow or careless. They are easy to recognize, with a look distinct from the other two factions. Their irregularly constructed bodies crafted from whatever they can get their rusted hands on.
